name: Apache Airflow & dbt
metaTitle: Apache Airflow and dbt Data Pipeline Development
description: Techlio builds automated ETL/ELT data pipelines, warehouse transformations, and data quality checks that keep analytics dashboards and AI models reliable.
h1: Data pipelines *that analytics and AI can rely on.*
answer: Apache Airflow schedules and monitors data pipelines, and dbt transforms data inside a warehouse with tested, version-controlled SQL. Techlio uses them to build pipelines that bring data together from apps, databases and files, check its quality, and keep dashboards and AI systems supplied with current data.

builds.title: ETL and ELT pipelines
builds.text: Scheduled and event-driven jobs that collect and load data from your systems.

builds.title: Warehouse transformations

builds.title: Data quality checks
builds.text: Automated checks and alerts that catch missing or wrong data before it reaches a dashboard or a model.

faqs.question: Do we need a data warehouse first?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily. Many AI systems start with a small, clean set of sources. We build what the use case needs.

faqs.question: Can you work with our existing tools?
faqs.answer: Yes. We build on what you have before suggesting anything new.
